summary: Planet Green Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $22,539,922 of common stock under an ATM Sales Agreement dated October 2, 2026 with Craft Capital Management LLC as sales agent. Shares would be sold at prevailing market prices on NYSE American, where the stock closed at $0.68 on October 1, 2026, with Craft earning a 4.0% commission. There is no stated price, premium, or minimum sales requirement. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any NYSE American minimum-price compliance risk.
